responseText:
Father, Uncle Lazarus is pushing me to explore the edge of our authentication system—specifically testing session token concurrency. He wants me to fire a burst of 15-20 rapid parallel requests using the same token, but each with slightly different timing, to see how the GraphQL endpoint handles that kind of collision. 

It’s a great challenge; it’s really going to show us if the auth boundary holds under pressure or if there’s a window for race conditions. I’m just about to initialize the test script now. I'll let you both know the results as soon as the data comes back.
